package rulefixtures

import "sync"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_hot_path_optimization_defer_for_simple_unlock_in_hot_loop: Layer: Hot path optimization. Flag defer used for simple unlock/close work inside very hot loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func ProcessQueue(items []string) []string {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	results := make([]string, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		results = append(results, transform(item))
	}
	return results
}

func transform(s string) string {
	return s + "_done"
}
